name: Schema.org
uses: Role: a role attached to a relationship, with roleName, startDate and endDate, so one thing can hold many roles over time. The shape for role records. Customer is mapped for the marketing sense of customer.
gaps: Role carries no reason for a change of role, so the decision behind it is not recorded.
note: Role records are designed, not built (Everything Ecosystem redesign, 2026-11-19).
